answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 100 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the vault here is verification, the thread of cost is what stops the farm, and the haven of the record keeps every claim checkable.
